C1784.title: FRAC Framework Design for Resisting Credential Fraud in Decentralized Identity Systems
C1784.summary: A study published in IEEE in March 2026 proposes the FRAC (Flexible Fraud-Resistant Access Control) framework to address credential fraud in decentralized identity systems, including credential theft and reuse of revoked credentials.
